title: Dynamic quotient
expected_pattern: raw libraries with distinct strategy identities but equal frontier and closure have identical finite-horizon values and policies
observed_pattern: 65/65 distinct raw-library pairs had equal K, values, and policies
formal_scope: Computational counterpart of supporting F1/F2; not the unproved raw T1 bridge.

title: Frontier–closure sufficiency
expected_pattern: frontier-only changes move passive operational value; closure-only changes move the research-option premium
observed_pattern: frontier-only: Δpassive=3//1, Δpremium=0//1; closure-only: Δpassive=0//1, Δpremium=4//1
formal_scope: Exact F5/F6 mechanism fixture; it does not establish raw-model T2.

title: Safe deletion
expected_pattern: stepwise deletion of strategies redundant in both components preserves compressed state, value, and policy
observed_pattern: two stepwise deletions reduced 4 strategies to 2 with identical K, horizon-3 value, and policy
formal_scope: Computational F3 counterpart; deletion is rechecked at every intermediate library.

title: Frontier-only pruning failure
expected_pattern: frontier-only pruning loss equals one half of the enabled future reward
observed_pattern: all 6 cases satisfy loss=future_reward/2; maximum loss=20//1
formal_scope: Exact supporting F4 construction; arbitrary loss comes from reward scaling, not normalized T4.

title: Value decomposition
expected_pattern: total innovation equals operational innovation plus the change in research-option premium
formal_scope: Exact F6 accounting mechanism; no unconditional general sign claim is inferred.

title: Coverage geometry and prospective ranking
expected_pattern: the four geometry fixtures retain their preregistered component counts; exact coverage potential recovers the same fixed-candidate ranking as date-first gross value; bounded score error preserves the separated top candidate; redundancy-aware marginal selection improves on individual-score top-k
observed_pattern: geometry components=(1,1,2,2); exact rank correlation=1; bounded-error top preserved; marginal top-2 value=69//4 versus redundant individual top-2 value=10//1
formal_scope: Exact S4/S5/C2 mechanism and limitation fixtures; ranking recovery holds only because the prospective target is the same fixed-candidate gross occupation value. Candidate T6 remains unproved.

title: Dynamic research policy
expected_pattern: research regions shrink with cost and delay, expand with discounting, and are mapped under persistence changes
observed_pattern: research counts cost=51/49/48, delay=59/49/40, persistence=46/49/53, discount=40/49/51 on 61 beliefs
formal_scope: Seeded Float64 F5/F8 compatibility policy map; no comparative-static theorem.
